Before you remix, please make sure that you followed all the rules:

Only @BarryFans, @ZYellow, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @Twin138956Scratch, @MisterChuChu, and @ScratchTeen9300 (as well as their other accounts) are allowed to break these rules.

Rules marked with a (!) can only be broken by BarryFans, nobody else!

(!) 1. Remember REMIX ETIQUETTE: Comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing...".

(!) 2. DO NOT BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES!! That means nothing too scary or vulgar & no swear words!

3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without permission! Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't completely change the project title either!

4. Don't delete or destructively modify anything you didn't make! You are allowed to do this though if something breaks any rules or the Community Guidelines or if you need to fix a bug or glitch.

5. Don't make your characters too large, that would make it hard to see. I would suggest scaling your character IN THE COSTUME EDITOR to match the size of the other characters before making your other costumes.

(!) 6. (PLEASE respect ZYellow's opinion on this) Please DON'T add any content from FNF, that means no characters, references, AND music tracks from that game. The reason why this rule exists is because FNF was involved in an incident with the New Oddball Mirror Hall. That incident caused problems for ZYellow much later and it tarnished his opinion on that game (if you like that game, then ZYellow respects your opinion).

7. Please refrain from adding any static images for characters, even if you attempt animate them, background included or not (EG: A PNG or JPEG of a Minecraft mob or some other thing).

8. I don't recommend adding any singular characters that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 character), unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them OR if one of them appears in a stunned costume of the other.

9. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the Community Guidelines. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to make sure you can't.

10. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so that it can't have too much lag from this project.

11. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it or completely change it altogether! I also recommend that you group your characters to prevent clutter.

If you break any of the rules, your OCs/Characters will be kicked out of the party when @BarryFans remixes.
